description: One GF1207 clear three-blade rotor, handedness +1; editable parameterized blade sections and hollow webbed hub. Local Z is aircraft frame datum.

provenance.feature: diameter, maximum chord, shaft bore, hub height and blade count
provenance.note: 31 mm swept diameter, 6.8 mm maximum unpitched section chord, 1 mm shaft bore, 3.3 mm hub height and three blades reference frozen central parameters. Their complete blade surface is not manufacturer CAD.

provenance.feature: swept radius under pitch and sweep
provenance.note: Span station X coordinates are normalized against the exact renderer elliptical-profile vertices. Maximum hypot(X,Y) is 15.5 mm, including all 48 samples per section and all caps; no blade modifiers change the envelope.
Shared estimated hub bottom z=11.35 mm, top z=14.65 mm, and blade midline reference z=12.5 mm. Component instance must translate only in XY.

PR-01 revision uses 61 shape-preserving span stations. Edge locations were qualitatively traced from the upper blade of prop_drawing, with neutral-pixel edge checks from image rows 370-725; no pixel-derived value is claimed verified. The outer 20 percent keeps much more chord and terminates in a broad 1.44 mm cap with short rounded corners instead of a pointed 0.06 mm endpoint. The inboard side edge is straighter; root begins at about 2.14 mm X to join the updated hub. Estimated twist is 34-to-9.8 degrees. Blade midline offsets remain -0.11 to +0.23 mm.

48-sample elliptical sections provide real thickness, rolled edges and twist; exact camber, pressure/suction surfaces, leading-edge radii and moulding ridges are unmeasured. This is visual geometry, not an aerodynamically certified propeller.

provenance.feature: hub outside diameter and three web apertures
provenance.note: PR-02: shared hub outer radius is now 2.4 mm, centrally approved after independent review, still an estimate within the original 1.9-2.5 mm uncertainty. The outer barrel wall remains 0.38 mm; center socket radius 0.93 mm and three 0.46 mm webs remain estimated. Web spans now depend on hub radius to preserve solid connections and three real apertures. The 1 mm bore and 3.3 mm height are unchanged.

provenance.feature: independent review response PR-01 and PR-02
provenance.note: Corrected broad terminal planform and straighter side edge after independent comparison of output/propulsion/top.png with reference imagery. The 2.4 mm hub radius was approved centrally before this component revision. Source diameter, maximum chord, hub height and bore remain fixed. Exact contour under perspective and pitch is uncertain.

nodes.notes: True hollow ring. Three open cavities lie between outer ring and center socket.
Actual 1.0 mm cylindrical through bore; edge bevel only opens the bore at the faces.
Length and radial center adapt to shared hub radius; webs overlap center socket and outer barrel after PR-02 hub revision.
